title: Classroom Scene 5 — Quiet Corner
purpose: Calm-state language, simple inference and positional description.

sentenceModels: The cat is on the beanbag.
The dog is sleeping on the rug.
The rabbit is next to the dog.
The fish bowl is on the shelf.

adultSupport.focus: Use this as a calm-language and 'where is it?' scene, not as a behaviour test.
starterPrompts: Who is next to the dog?
expansionPrompts: What could you do in a quiet corner?
Can you tell me a full sentence about the dog?
